about_the_game:
Bloom is a short point-and-click narrative puzzle game that draws you into a haunting dreamscape. You play as a housewife who suddenly finds herself stalked by a terrifying creature known as the Root-Man. Every corner hides danger, every choice carries weight, and every second brings you closer to either freedom—or eternal entrapment.

Your goal is simple: find the key, open the door, and escape. But nothing is as it seems. You’ll need to solve puzzles, make choices through dialogue, and uncover fragments of story hidden in the shadows. The Root-Man is always near, and the nightmare won’t let you go so easily…

Features:

  • Point-and-click narrative gameplay: classic interaction with a modern, eerie twist.

  • Challenging puzzles to solve : unlock doors, uncover secrets, and piece together the way out.

  • Dialogue choices : shape your housewife’s responses and uncover different layers of the nightmare.

  • Cutscenes: cinematic sequences that deepen the atmosphere and bring the terror closer.

Will you escape the clutches of the Root-Man, or will the nightmare bloom around you forever?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+ 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530/NVIDIA GT 730/AMD Radeon R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4GB/AMD RX 560 4GB/Intel Iris Xe Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Bloom is a short point-and-click narrative puzzle game. Step into the role of a housewife haunted by the terrifying Root-Man. Search for keys, unlock doors, and fight to escape. Will you wake from the nightmare, or remain trapped forever?
